revision: photo-informed Waveshare LCD HAT with FH-00339 low-profile SMT female GPIO socket

meta.coordinate_system: XY centred, PCB bottom Z=0, mm

photo_derived_dimensions.gpio_mating_datum: Photo-registered underside -Y header,centre Y3.60; rows2.33/4.87 at2.54 pitch. User-selected FH-00339,not an identified OEM connector.
photo_derived_dimensions.photo_mask_opening_status: Shallow solder-mask impressions only; photographs do not establish through-drill depth
photo_derived_dimensions.exposed_pad_surface_finish: Silver tin/nickel visual finish from official front/back photographs

meta.board_drawing_coordinate_system: Origin at lower-left of 65 x 30.2 PCB outline; X right; Y up; Z=0 at PCB bottom. Joystick left, keys right, GPIO on underside near -Y.
accuracy_notes: Published board size, mounting hole pitch, mounting drill radius and active display area are the dimensioned constraints.

The 26.16 x 29.22 panel drawing is a related official Waveshare panel datasheet; a matching part number for the original HAT was not published. Panel stack dimensions and the shifted active area are conditional estimates.
Button, joystick, FPC, via and passive placement and heights were estimated from product photos; these are visual CAD geometry, not a manufacturing drawing.

The underside schematic identifies three resistors, C1 and S8050 Q1. Their package dimensions are estimates and positions follow the registered official back photograph. R3 is marked102 and R2 is marked103.

Copper routes follow only visible photo contours, with6micrometre mask relief; the FPC copper crosshatch is visual reconstruction. The dark flex patch is not asserted to be an independently identified IC.

KEY1/KEY2/KEY3, primary back legends, Waveshare logo approximation and resistor codes have thin STEP-visible white ink geometry. Fine FPC manufacturing typography and minor artwork remain texture-only.

Visible PCB solder lands and the twelve flex fingers have a silver tin/nickel finish following the official photos; protected internal socket contacts and the amber flex copper/rings retain their gold/copper appearance.

The underside female header is the user-selected Liansheng FH-00339 replacement, using the manufacturer drawing nominal51.2x5.0x3.5mm body and 3.9mm overall mounted height. The drawing optional W=WithPost locators are omitted to preserve the existing PCB. Mating cavities and spring profiles remain reconstruction; the original Waveshare connector BOM identity is unconfirmed.
meta.printed_legend_scale_status: Glyph runs normalized to photo-measured widths; main logo and registered mark have independent photo footprints. Primary legends retain STEP-visible glyph solids.

gpio_connector.selected_variant: No optional locator posts; W=WithPost omitted
gpio_connector.contact_plating: Au over Ni; PCB solder lands retain photo-based silver finish
gpio_connector.locator_omission_reason: Optional W variant excluded; existing PCB has no locator bores
gpio_connector.cavity_and_spring_profiles: Reconstructed; un-dimensioned internals in manufacturer drawing
gpio_connector.PCB_land_fit_note: Photo-registered CY3.60 retained; lower-row lands/solder clipped at existing PCB Y0. Manufacturer recommended footprint is not asserted as the reused HAT PCB footprint.
gpio_connector.selection_basis: Explicit user-selected replacement,not asserted as original Waveshare BOM

meta.header_revision: User-selected FH-00339 no-post connector:3.5mm body,3.9mm mounted height,2.54mm pitch

surface_finish_update.verification_scope: Historical material-only stage before the FH-00339 geometry replacement; current preservation is limited to329 non-header parts.

fh00339_header_revision.contact_plating: Au over Ni per drawing; exposed PCB pads remain silver

FH00339_independent_CAD_roundtrip.BRep_comparison_method: Only final root Free state bit excluded; all remaining text/tokens compared, numerical definitions <=1e-12; topology, volume, analytic bounds and vertices checked; numerical definition outliers additionally tested with bidirectional on-trim/support witnesses

reference.standoff_status: 0.4 mm inferred from published 3.9 overall minus 3.5 body
reference.locator_post_status: Optional drawing posts omitted; existing PCB preserved
